g.text: Stop impeller and play triumphant chi…

text.tspan: A beverage vessel (10) rests on a powered base (20).
A magnet (32) in the base turns an impeller (30)
sealed in the floor of the vessel, stirring the
beverage without a spoon. A temperature sensor (24)
and a controller estimate when added sugar has fully
dissolved, stop the impeller, and sound a short,
triumphant chime. The handle (12) is positioned for
either hand, and the base charges wirelessly.

svg.text: Drawn with patent-drawing, a Claude skill. Not a filed or issued patent.
